narration: But the state where it all happens, Leonida, is not made up.
title: IS LEONIDA REAL?

narration: Almost every road, beach and swamp in the trailers has a real twin in Florida.
So we put them side by side. Here are the six regions of Leonida, and the real places behind them.
Region one. Vice City.
title: VICE CITY
subtitle: Region of Leonida

narration: Vice City is Miami. The highways, the skyline, even the green exit signs match.
Glass towers, palm trees, and planes coming in low over downtown, just like the real thing.
Then there's the beach. Vice Beach is Miami Beach, down to the lifeguard towers and the hotel strip behind the sand.
At night, the neon strip comes alive. Art deco hotels, glowing signs, and slow cars cruising past the crowds.
The clubs are pure Miami nightlife too.
Even the marinas are packed with yachts, just like the real ones off Miami Beach.
Region two. The Leonida Keys.
title: LEONIDA KEYS
subtitle: Region of Leonida

narration: These are the Florida Keys: a chain of small islands hanging off the bottom of the state, linked by long bridges.
In the trailer, locals live right on the water, in old houses with beat-up pickups out front.
And out on the water, it's jet skis and speedboats, exactly like a summer weekend down south.
Region three. Grassrivers.
title: GRASSRIVERS
subtitle: Region of Leonida

narration: Grassrivers is the Everglades: endless sawgrass, mangroves, and slow brown water.
The trailer even shows an airboat chase through the swamp, with a helicopter right on its tail.
And of course, alligators. In Leonida they turn up in swimming pools. In Florida, that actually happens.
Region four. Ambrosia.
title: AMBROSIA
subtitle: Region of Leonida

narration: Ambrosia is farm country, built around a sugar refinery. Fans point to the sugar towns around Lake Okeechobee.
It's flat, dusty and wide open. The kind of place where bikers own the back roads.
Region five. Port Gellhorn.
title: PORT GELLHORN
subtitle: Region of Leonida

narration: Up on the Gulf coast, Port Gellhorn feels like Florida's Panhandle: faded beach towns, old motels and cheap neon.
It's the forgotten side of the state, far from the Miami glamour.
Region six. Mount Kalaga National Park.
title: MOUNT KALAGA
subtitle: Region of Leonida

narration: Here's the twist. Florida has no real mountains. So Rockstar invented one, with forests, trails and hunting grounds.
It's the one part of Leonida that's more fantasy than Florida.
And then there's the part Rockstar copied most closely: the headlines.
title: THE HEADLINES
subtitle: Leonida = Florida

narration: The trailers are full of viral phone videos, police chases and mugshots, a parody of the stories Florida is famous for online.
In Leonida, Florida Man is basically a game mechanic.
So how big is all this? Fans who mapped the trailers estimate Leonida is roughly twice the size of GTA five's map.
title: Leonida ≈ 2× GTA V
subtitle: fan estimate

narration: That would make it the biggest world Rockstar has ever built.
